performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (1) 📘 Rule violations (0) 📜 Skill insights (0)
1. Custom provider hook bypassed 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness
>
>Description >
> >
>Passing self.untag as object_hook prevents custom JSON providers from installing their own
>object hook, so provider-specific values remain undecoded during tagged or session deserialization.
>Providers backed by libraries that do not accept Python's object_hook keyword may instead fail
>every load with an exception.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[src/flask/json/tag.py[315]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/pull/6239/files#diff-809a1a0be75dbb211a5a290f9cac295c7703138d9ebd9fc79777cd228865dac9R315-R315) > >```diff >+ return loads(value, object_hook=self.untag) >``` >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>Flask's top-level loads delegates all keyword arguments to current_app.json.loads, and providers
>are explicitly customizable or may use other JSON libraries. The repository's own custom-provider
>example installs its hook with kwargs.setdefault("object_hook", self.object_hook); because the
>changed line already supplies that key, the provider hook is no longer installed. This serializer is
>also the default secure-cookie session serializer, extending the regression to session loading.
>
> > [src/flask/json/tag.py[313-315]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/e0914ed00088f068b79928735ef3b9a44fff35a2/src/flask/json/tag.py/#L313-L315) > [src/flask/json/__init__.py[77-105]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/e0914ed00088f068b79928735ef3b9a44fff35a2/src/flask/json/__init__.py/#L77-L105) > [src/flask/json/provider.py[19-30]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/e0914ed00088f068b79928735ef3b9a44fff35a2/src/flask/json/provider.py/#L19-L30) > [tests/test_json.py[234-243]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/e0914ed00088f068b79928735ef3b9a44fff35a2/tests/test_json.py/#L234-L243) > [src/flask/sessions.py[273-300]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/e0914ed00088f068b79928735ef3b9a44fff35a2/src/flask/sessions.py/#L273-L300) >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >`TaggedJSONSerializer.loads` now passes `object_hook=self.untag` through Flask's configurable JSON provider. This overrides provider-defined hooks and may pass an unsupported Python-specific keyword to alternate JSON implementations. > >## Issue Context >Previously, the provider completed its normal deserialization before tagged dictionaries were recursively converted. Preserve that ordering and avoid requiring custom providers to support or compose an `object_hook` argument. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/flask/json/tag.py[297-315] >- src/flask/json/__init__.py[77-105] >- tests/test_json.py[223-245] >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
